provenance: 26.9 spec declares no body; server requires one; live 400 vs 200, 2026-10-15
about: The CCC 26.9 spec declares the three AD group views (getGroupsView, getGroupUsers, getGroupDevices) as POSTs with requestBody: null, so the generator would give them no --body and send nothing. The server rejects a bodiless POST: on release-demos.idp02 (CCC 26.9.0), POST /api/ad-connector-service/v1/groups?size=5 with no body returned HTTP 400, and with body {} and Content-Type: application/json returned HTTP 200 (an empty Spring page). This overlay gives each view an optional application/json object body and makes the command send {} when the user passes neither --body nor --body-file. Apply with: python3 generate_commands.py --spec <26.9 spec> --overlay spec-overlays/ccc-26.9-hotpatch-device-patch.json --overlay spec-overlays/ccc-26.9-ad-group-views-body.json. Each key is set only where the spec leaves it empty, so a spec that declares a requestBody keeps its own. Remove this file once the published spec declares the bodies.
